audit.why: EVEN at 5.5/10 against 53.99% over 1341 games. The lane's shape is right on the content layer: yours at 3-5 while his sustain is thin, his from 6 once Demonic Ascension can hold a fight open indefinitely ('This form is indefinite as long as Swain drains enemy champions'). I did not move diff, because packet.defects flags the chart itself as contradicting the win rate and the two are one unresolved unit — see notes.

The spike map is sound and the ability name is right — note that packet.suspectNames flags "Demonic Ascension's" in whys[4] as a probable wrong name at distance 2; that is a FALSE POSITIVE caused by the possessive apostrophe. Real spikes: Nevermove online early (12s at rank 1, 850 range), Demonic Ascension at 6 on 120s flat, Galio's Justice Punch at 3 (11s) and Hero's Entrance at 6 (180s).

audit.whatIsWrong: Three mechanical errors: (a) Justice Punch is called a stun in whys[2] and early — it knocks up; (b) Ravenous Flock is described as stacked DAMAGE ('before he's stacked ravenous flock damage', 'stack Ravenous Flock damage on you with autos') when it is a heal; (c) nothing on the page says Nevermove roots on the RETURN pass, which is the entire timing of the matchup.
audit.why: ownerKit E knocks up the first champion hit. enemyKit P: 'Swain's ravens collect Soul Fragments that heal him and permanently increase his maximum health' — heal and percentHealth flags, no damage stacking. enemyKit E: 'Swain launches a wave of demonic power forward. It then returns to Swain and roots enemies it hits. Swain can then choose to pull all rooted champions closer.' 12/11.5/11/10.5/10, 850 range. missingInteractions flags both needs-antiheal and resistances-invalidated on the passive.
audit.corrected: Justice Punch knocks up. Ravenous Flock heals him and grows his max health, so Grievous Wounds — not more MR — is the answer, and his passive punishes flat HP stacking. Nevermove roots on the way back, so the throw is your window to step in and the return is the thing to dodge.

audit.why: Nevermove 12/11.5/11/10.5/10 is the punishable cooldown; Demonic Ascension is 120s at every rank; Death's Hand falls to 3s at rank 5 so it is not a window at all.
audit.corrected: All three written in, with the 'wait for X before you Y' sequencing the packet asked for: step in on the Nevermove throw, commit on its 12 seconds.

audit.whatIsWrong: The itemisation advice on this page is 'MR is your damage' with anti-heal mentioned only once, in report[8].t.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags resistances-invalidated: Ravenous Flock's permanent max-health growth and healing mean stacking resistances alone does not solve him, and needs-antiheal makes Grievous Wounds timing the decider in extended trades.
